build.buildCommand: if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "worker" ]; then pnpm turbo run build --filter=@pulso/worker...; else pnpm turbo run build --filter=@pulso/api...; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "worker" ]; then exec node --import tsx apps/worker/dist/main.js; else pnpm db:deploy && exec node --import tsx apps/api/dist/main.js; fi
